# Step - statistics

`statistics` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Returns the graph's counts: vertices and edges in total and per label.

## Forms

```text
statistics()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.statistics()["vertex_labels"]   // #{"person": 4, "software": 2}
```
